grades.upper_bound_mechanism: finite prime-support periodicity and residue count
grades.notes: Complete proof. It establishes support-based self-duality, proves finiteness of minimal accepted supports for all cases using sunflower finiteness and strict weight descent, and derives membership invariance modulo the finite prime product from m=a_1 onward. Counting accepted residues gives the claimed identity for every n.
